findings.text: the negative control reads "with the strip for a launch that seeds no server removed, wherever the node places it (the instruction owner or the launch caller), the first test fails", but the launch caller invokes the instruction owner only under `if anchored_edit:` (`reckon/_backends.py:3112-3119`) and the owner returns early for a backend whose `anchored_edit` is not true (`reckon/crew/prompts.py:666`), so a strip placed inside the owner alone never runs on a launch that seeds no server and the control holds for a reason other than the fix

response_events.reason: a strip placed in the owner only works if the node also makes the launch caller reach the owner for a non-seeding launch, so removing that strip still makes the first test fail; the control is stated as behaviour and holds for either placement
